chunks: (The light is lit) in houses of worship which God has allowed to be raised, and His name remembered in them. His praises are sung there morning and evening,
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of houses of worship in Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nur is often interpreted to include both the Prophet's Mosque in Medina and the shrine of Imam Ali in Kufa, emphasizing the spiritual elevation of these sacred spaces. The mention of 'morning and evening' (al-ghudu wa al-asal) underscores the continuity of divine remembrance, linking the physical sanctity of the mosque with the perpetual devotion of the faithful.
